instructions.text: Heat a medium non-stick pan and lightly spray with cooking spray.
Chop the mushrooms and spinach, then add them to the pan. Season with salt and pepper and saut‚ until soft. Remove from the pan and set aside.
1n a small bowl, whisk the whole egg and egg whites with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Respray the pan and pour in the egg mixture. Cook for 1-2 minutes until just set.
Place the wrap directly on top of the eggs, pressing gently to adhere. Flip and toast for another minute.
Transfer to a plate, top with the saut‚ed mushrooms, spinach, and grated cheddar.
Sprinkle with EBTB seasoning, fold, and enjoy!
